rice.notes: Mainly Kharif nursery raising in May-July, transplanting June-August. Also sown as Boro rice in Nov-Jan in Eastern India.

wheat.notes: Staple Rabi cereal. Optimal sowing in Indo-Gangetic Plains between late October and late November. Harvesting March-April.

maize.notes: Predominantly Kharif (sown June-July with monsoon onset), also grown as Rabi corn in Peninsular India (sown Oct-Nov).

chickpea.notes: Primary Rabi cool-season pulse. Optimal sowing October-November; terminal drought sensitive in February-March.

kidneybeans.notes: Grown in Himalayan hills during Kharif (May-July) and in North-Eastern plains as early winter pulse (Oct-Nov).

pigeonpeas.notes: Arhar/Tur is sown with first monsoon showers in June-July. Maturity takes 150-200 days, harvesting December-January.

mothbeans.notes: Highly drought-tolerant arid legume grown primarily in Rajasthan/Gujarat. Sown July with monsoon onset, harvested Oct.

mungbean.notes: Short duration 60-day pulse. Sown in Zaid (March-April) after Rabi harvest, and in Kharif (June-July).

blackgram.notes: Urad pulse is sown in Kharif (June-July) across Central India, and in coastal rice-fallow Rabi (Nov-Dec).

lentil.notes: Masoor pulse is sown late October to mid-November across UP, MP, and Bihar; harvested February-March.

pomegranate.notes: Perennial orchard crop. Managed via regulated flowering flushes (Mrig Bahar in June, Hasta in Sept, Ambe in Jan).

banana.notes: Tissue culture suckers planted in Spring (Feb-March) or Monsoon (June-July). Avoid severe winter frost periods.

mango.notes: Orchard establishment ideal during monsoon (July-August). Fruit harvest spans March to July.

grapes.notes: Foundation pruning in April, forward pruning for fruit development in October. Harvest February-April.

watermelon.notes: Warm season cucurbit. Best sown in late winter / early summer (January-March) for peak harvest before monsoon.

muskmelon.notes: Summer cucurbit. Ideal sowing January to March. High heat and dry sunny weather needed for sugar accumulation.

apple.notes: Temperate tree fruit requiring chilling hours (>800 hours <7°C). Dormant bareroot planting December-February.

orange.notes: Mandarin/Mosambi citrus orchard planting during active monsoon (July-September).

papaya.notes: Fast-growing fruit. Transplant seedlings in Spring (Feb-March) or Monsoon (July-August).

coconut.notes: Long-lived coastal palm. Seedling pit transplanting recommended with South-West monsoon onset (May-September).

cotton.notes: Sown April-May (irrigated North India) or June-July with monsoon onset (rainfed Central/South India). Harvest Oct-Dec.

jute.notes: Sown March to May with pre-monsoon showers in Bengal and Assam; harvested 120 days later at flower initiation.

coffee.notes: Shade-loving plantation shrub in Western Ghats. Transplanting during monsoon (June-August). Harvest Nov-Feb.
